create_MockConfigLoader: create a MockConfigLoader instance with a config base path and optional path replacement mappings
run_make_config: run make_config to load a PyText config JSON file from disk and return a processed config dict
run_make_config_from_dict: run make_config_from_dict to process a config dict by upgrading, disabling tensorboard, and fixing paths
run_disable_cuda: run disable_cuda on a config dict to set use_cuda_if_available to false and remove distributed settings
run_fix_paths: run fix_paths on a config to recursively replace path strings using the configured replace_paths mapping
